collection: Original-language Hebrew/Yiddish Likkutei Sichos and Hebrew Igrot Kodesh correspondence; in-place enrichment and identity reconciliation.
source_authority: Chabad.org / TheRebbe.org, Kehot Publication Society; existing user-supplied Kehot scan used only as a same-letter comparison.
review_method: Direct web.open inspection of eleven item-level public source bodies. Eight existing Likkutei Sichos identities received one additional non-verbatim proposition each; AID 5168552 was reopened but its visible Yiddish passage was already covered. Two existing Igrot Kodesh bibliographic/content identities were enriched in place: AID 4929245 was linked to the existing volume XI letter identity and received two propositions; AID 4994228 was linked to the existing volume XIII scan identity as the same printed letter, with no new proposition and no independent-witness count.

limitations: All eight enriched Likkutei Sichos records remain Parsed; only the specific original Hebrew/Yiddish passages in their locators were inspected.
AID 5168552 was rechecked; the visible original-Yiddish passage was already represented by its existing proposition, so no duplicate was added.
AID 4929245 was an existing bibliographic identity; the full visible publisher response body was inspected, but the incoming letter and autograph were not. Its context remains partial.

AID 4994228 was an existing scan-based identity; the public publisher page and user-supplied scan are the same printed letter, not independent witnesses. No new Evidence Family or proposition was added.
Seven attempted AID pages redirected to summary/navigation shells and were excluded. Accessible publisher item pages were used as fallback in the same run.
No full copyrighted text was copied, no access controls were bypassed, and no AI inference was attributed to the Rebbe.
